project.name: Syirkah Foundation - Aggregator
project.description:
Phase 1 platform kernel (Docs/Plan/base01.md §18, §P1-01):
foundation-kernel id, time, result, error, lifecycle, value foundation-domain pure Java DDD kit (artifact syirkah-foundation) foundation-application CQRS kit, Mutiny (artifact syirkah-foundation-application) foundation-testing shared test doubles + ArchUnit rules foundation-adapter replaceable infrastructure adapters
Dependency direction is one-way and enforced by ArchUnit:
Adapter -> Application -> Domain -> Kernel
